meta.name: keyword-research
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "find keywords", "挖词", or "搜什么词"; prioritizes search volume, keyword difficulty, intent, and topic clusters from provided or connected data. Not for competitor-relative coverage gaps — use content-gap-analysis. 关键词研究/内容选题

copy.tagline: 挖掘高价值关键词，指导内容选题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做内容营销或SEO，需要找到用户搜索的词
copy.tagline_en: Find high-value keywords to guide content topics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you do content marketing or SEO and need to find what users search for

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你做关键词研究：根据你给的种子词，搜索并整理出关键词的搜索量、难度、用户意图，并按主题分组，最后给出优先推荐。
howto.when: 当你要求“找关键词”、“挖词”、“搜什么词”，或者询问搜索量、关键词难度、长尾词、内容选题时触发。

say.text: 帮我找“智能手表”的关键词，中文市场。
say.note: Claude 会执行8步流程，输出关键词列表和机会分析。

say.text: 分析“best running shoes”的搜索量和难度。
say.note: Claude 会评估该词并给出机会评分。

say.text: 为我的新博客“健康饮食”做内容选题。
say.note: Claude 会生成主题集群和内容日历。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you do keyword research: given a seed term, it discovers and scores keywords by search volume, difficulty, and intent, groups them into topic clusters, and delivers prioritized recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "find keywords", "挖词", "搜什么词", or inquire about search volume, keyword difficulty, long-tail keywords, or content topics.

say_en.text: Find keywords for "smartwatch" in Chinese market.
say_en.note: Claude runs 8 phases and outputs a keyword list with opportunity analysis.

say_en.text: Analyze search volume and difficulty for "best running shoes".
say_en.note: Claude evaluates the term and gives an opportunity score.

say_en.text: Do content topic research for my new blog "healthy eating".
say_en.note: Claude generates topic clusters and a content calendar.
